transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, what brings me in is... I keep planning my days around not having to drive over those high bridges. It's just becoming a real hassle. And if I absolutely can't find a way around it, I just white-knuckle it the whole way across. I figured it was probably time to come in and talk to someone about it.
Do you also fear or avoid other situations where you might have difficulty escaping or getting help, such as public transportation, crowds, or being outside alone?

No, not really. I don't have any issues with that kind of stuff. I mean, public transit is fine, and I don't mind crowds or being out by myself at all. It's really just... just those high bridges, honestly.
